purpose: Convert the M1 fleet matrix into implementation-neutral remediation patterns and a safe order of work without changing any target.

guardrails.principle: A shared recipe may standardize the contract and proof shape, never fabricate target evidence or silently port target-specific code.

pattern_ledger.shared_fix_shape: Replace reusable PID/liveness-based stale-marker decisions with a grantor-observable authority (for example, an OS advisory lock or an equivalent lease/fencing authority). Keep diagnostic metadata non-authoritative.
pattern_ledger.code_reuse_policy: Share the invariant, acceptance tests, and review checklist; do not copy a Watch/OEM implementation without checking each target's process, filesystem, and runtime boundary.
proof_gates: The real execution path acquires the authority before work and releases it on normal and abnormal termination.
A stale/reused PID or hostname cannot by itself authorize reclaim, termination, or duplicate execution.
A contention test demonstrates refusal/serialization and a release test demonstrates recovery after owner death.
All prior lock metadata remains diagnostic only, with no alternate caller consulting it as authority.

pattern_ledger.pattern: Qualification provenance, material-change reset, and gate-agreement evidence
pattern_ledger.shared_fix_shape: Use a durable, append-only qualification/epoch record that carries authority-supplied trigger provenance, explicit prior material identity on reset, reset reason/time, and gate-visible evidence. Natural, manual, deploy-verification, and recovery paths remain distinguishable; missing provenance is UNKNOWN/fail-closed.
pattern_ledger.code_reuse_policy: Share the data contract, state-transition invariants, and adversarial test vectors. Each target must bind its own scheduler/manual/deploy/recovery paths and its own material-change detector.
proof_gates: Every real trigger path supplies provenance structurally; no downstream fallback fabricates NATURAL.
A material change creates a new qualification epoch before the first changed-run event is evaluated.
The reset record contains the explicit prior material identity and reason; stale pre-reset evidence cannot satisfy the new gate.
Natural/manual/deploy/recovery runs remain distinguishable and UNKNOWN is preserved when provenance is absent.
Independent gates cannot silently disagree; divergence fails closed and is recorded.

excluded_targets.chinese-tech-wire: No promotion path was counted in M1.
excluded_targets.smartphone-clank: No promotion/soak lifecycle was counted in M1.

pattern_ledger.shared_fix_shape: Add or verify a pre-normal-work compatibility barrier that compares the deployed code's required persistent-state contract with the target state, fails closed on known mismatch, and records the compatibility refusal. Migration framework/order remains target-specific.
pattern_ledger.code_reuse_policy: Share the gate contract, failure vocabulary, and regression scenarios; do not prescribe Alembic, SQL, create_all, startup, or rollout mechanics across targets.
proof_gates: The actual normal-work entrypoint crosses the compatibility barrier first.
Known incompatible code/state refuses normal work and leaves an identifying record.
Connectivity, table existence, process start, and migration-command success alone cannot pass the gate.
Fresh, upgraded, stale, and partially-migrated target states are covered by focused tests.

positive_exception.smartphone-clank: M1 source evidence identifies database/schema_guard.py as a positive implementation; preserve and independently re-check it during the fleet re-audit.

pattern_ledger.shared_fix_shape: Share Watch's read-only comparator and evidence schema only. There is no transferable target evidence: intended artifact/revision, target environment, configuration, wiring, and materially running identity must be observed per target.
pattern_ledger.code_reuse_policy: Common proof mechanism is allowed; target identity, target scope, artifact provenance, and result are never inherited from Watch or another Clank.
proof_gates: The target environment/scope is named in the completion claim.
Intended and running artifact/revision provenance are comparable and trustworthy.
Deploy-critical configuration and required runtime wiring are observed where applicable.
Partial/in-progress convergence is represented as partial, never complete.
The proof is read-only and occurs only after source remediation and re-audit are green.

pattern_ledger.pattern: Empty target trigger facts in fleet-adoption.json
pattern_ledger.shared_fix_shape: Do not silently populate or mutate registry facts as part of remediation. Treat source-trigger confirmation and any future profile-fact update as a separately authorized governance decision.
proof_gates: A future resolver/profile change must cite target source evidence and preserve UNKNOWN semantics.

remediation_order.name: Close actual lock-authority defects
remediation_order.why_first: These are the only M1 NON_CONFORMING findings, and both share the same PID/OpenProcess defect family.
remediation_order.safe_boundary: Source-only changes and focused target tests; no deployment or host verification.
remediation_order.exit_gate: Independent source re-audit shows CONFORMS for OPS-COM-004 in both targets.

remediation_order.name: Apply common source-level evidence recipes
remediation_order.why_now: Qualification and compatibility are source-level prerequisites for honest deployment proof; the contract and adversarial tests can be shared while integration remains per target.
remediation_order.safe_boundary: No target implementation starts from this ledger alone; each target needs an independently authorized remediation pass and a target-specific test plan.
remediation_order.exit_gate: Every affected target has target-local structural evidence and focused tests for its applicable pattern, with UNKNOWN/fail-closed behavior preserved.

remediation_order.name: Fleet source re-audit
remediation_order.why_now: A clean source state must be established before any production observation is allowed to influence DEPLOY-COM-001.
remediation_order.safe_boundary: Read-only source audit and safe focused regression tests; no host action and no evidence admission.
remediation_order.exit_gate: Per-target re-audit records current applicability and state; no unresolved source defect is silently carried into live proof.

remediation_order.name: Per-target read-only live deployment proofs
remediation_order.why_last: Live materialization evidence is meaningful only after source-level contracts and compatibility gates are independently re-audited.
remediation_order.safe_boundary: Read-only comparator only; no deploy, restart, config mutation, scheduler change, or recovery action.
remediation_order.exit_gate: Each target separately reaches a complete or explicitly partial result with trustworthy intended/running identity, config, wiring, and scope evidence.

decision: Use shared contracts, invariants, and proof gates to reduce duplicated reasoning, but keep implementation and evidence per target. Do not begin remediation or live proof from this planning artifact alone.
